Your time

Every free session costs you an hour

Your free first session is generous, but it has no filter in front of it. You spend the hour before you know if someone is ready, able to invest, or just curious.

Your Linktree

Your followers buy, just not from you

Over 20 links send people to partner brands with your codes, and one link goes to coaching. Your audience already acts on your recommendations. There’s no product of yours in that list.

Reach

Growth tied to the next post

Recipes and posts bring people in, but who sees your coaching depends on how each post does that week. There’s no steady way to put your offer in front of new people every day.

People already trust your taste in food and wellness enough to buy what you recommend. The missing piece is a first thing of yours to say yes to.

A $17 live class, “Feels Good, Tastes Better”, built on The Live Well Method

Questions

Before you save your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because people who invest, even a little, show up and actually try what they learn. I want a room full of women ready to make one small change.

Is this a diet?

No. There are no rules, no counting and no strict plan. It’s about simple food and habits that feel good and fit your life.

Is this medical advice?

No. The class is educational content and coaching-style support. It doesn’t replace your doctor or care team. For anything medical, please speak with your own provider.

What if I can’t make it live?

Save your seat anyway. Every seat includes the full replay.

Will you talk about coaching at the end?

For the last few minutes I’ll share how to apply to work with me, for anyone who wants to go further. Everything before that is yours to use either way.
